subject: Sell-With eligibility and packaging: CloudWorks connector evidence needed
messages:

Cc: Devon Harris <devon@cloudworks.io>
Date: Thu, 22 May 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Sell-With eligibility pack for CloudWorks connector

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for taking the call earlier. We want to get CloudWorks listed as a Sell-With partner across AWS/GCP — the integration (connector) will be offered as a managed SaaS + optional AMI for customers. AWS asked us for the Sell-With eligibility evidence and a partner packaging plan.

Can you share Redwood's checklist and the minimum evidence set you need for marketplace co-sell (technical evidence, security artifacts, sample billing SKU, and a short demo recording)? We're trying to move this through our channel ops this quarter.

High-level asks from our side:
- What does Redwood need to demonstrate to be considered "compatible" for co-sell (billing, entitlements, metering)?
- Any requirements for AMI/container packaging vs SaaS listing?
- Timeline estimates for validation and evidence review.

Attaching a one-pager for the connector (sent as link in next email). Thanks — happy to hop on a short sync if that's easier.

Best,
Kara (on behalf of CloudWorks Partnerships)

--

Partnerships team

Folks — looping you in. CloudWorks is pushing for Sell-With across AWS/GCP and wants to understand what evidence we need to support their listing + co-sell. Key asks: security artifacts, architecture diagram, metering/billing SKU, and a demo clip.

Short plan proposal from Redwood:
1) Security + compliance: provide SOC2 summary, data flow diagram, and data residency notes. (owner: Olga)
2) Technical: connector architecture diagram, supported deployment patterns (SaaS, AMI), compatibility notes for our runtime. (owner: Ben)
3) Commercial/metering: draft billing SKU mapping and suggested entitlement model for marketplaces. (owner: Vivek)
4) Demo: 3–4 minute recorded walkthrough focused on multi-tenant behavior and admin UX. (owner: CloudWorks / we can co-record)

Olga — can you pull the evidence binder template (redwood security-evidence-binder.zip) and confirm SOC2 lines we can share? Ben — can you sketch an arch diagram and short readme for AMI vs SaaS packaging constraints? Vivek — I will share existing billing-sku template — please adapt to CloudWorks scenarios and highlight any required billing integration work.

I'll also reach out to the AWS partner manager to confirm Sell-With checklist items and any AWS-specific entitlements we should prepare.

Thanks,
Rishi

- SOC2 scoping summary (acceptable)

Attachments referenced: connector-arch-diagram.png (draft), security-evidence-binder.zip (stub).

Subject: Fwd: Sell-With eligibility pack for CloudWorks connector — quick AWS Qs

Kara — thanks for reaching out (CloudWorks partnership thread below). We're preparing the evidence pack and would appreciate a quick confirmation from AWS on a few items so we can prioritize: 

1) For "Sell-With" eligibility, is a SOC2 summary + architecture + demo sufficient for initial validation, or does AWS require the full SOC2 report at first pass?
2) For entitlements, does AWS prefer a single SKU with usage metering (e.g., monthly tokens) or discrete SKUs per feature tier? Any guidance on how to model bundled offers (Redwood runtime + CloudWorks connector managed service) would help.
3) Packaging: does AWS treat an AMI listing differently from SaaS (do they require AMI hardening checklist to be submitted separately)?

We have an internal timeline: can assemble a provisional pack (arch diagram, SOC2 summary, demo) within 7 business days; full AMI packaging would take ~2–3 weeks. Please advise if AWS needs the AMI to proceed with co-sell.

HubSpot deal referenced: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deal/CLW-088
DocuSign (CloudWorks NDA): https://www.docusign.com/en/link/CLW-SellWith-Agreement

Appreciate a quick pointer so we can align CloudWorks and Redwood timelines.

Best,
Rishi
From: Kara Liu - AWS Partner Manager <kara.liu@amazon.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: CloudWorks Integrations <partnerships@cloudworks.io>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Jun 2025 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Sell-With eligibility pack for CloudWorks connector — quick AWS Qs

Hi Rishi / CloudWorks team — thanks for the context. Quick answers from AWS side: 

1) Initial validation: SOC2 summary + architecture diagram + demo is sufficient for an initial Sell-With validation and to open a co-sell case. We will request the full SOC2 report later if the opportunity advances to procurement or a compliance gate.
2) Entitlements: AWS prefers a single metered SKU when possible; map to a usage unit (calls/min or monthly active customers) rather than product feature SKUs. For hybrid offers (Redwood runtime + CloudWorks connector), list a primary SKU for the connector and use add-on SKUs for managed services. We can share a sample SKU template — please send the billing-sku-mapping.xlsx once ready.
3) Packaging: AMI listings are handled separately. For Sell-With you do not need an AMI to start, but if you plan to offer an AMI in the Marketplace we will need the hardened image checklist and a QA pass before publication.

Next steps:
- Please upload draft artifacts to the HubSpot deal (link above).
- Share billing-sku-mapping.xlsx and a short demo clip (3–5 min).
- AWS can run a preliminary co-sell intake call — propose Thu, Jun 12 at 10:00 PT for a 30-min intake (I will send a calendar invite if that works).

Happy to help — Kara
AWS GTM Partnerships
